7.4.4 Data byte mapping
[SWS_Lin_00096] ⌈Data mapping between memory and the LIN frame is defined in a
way that the array element 0 is containing the LSB (the data byte to send/receive first)
and the array element (n-1) is containing the MSB (the data byte to send/receive last).⌋
